channel.title: HomerDev Walkthroughs
channel.description: Spoken walks through the Homer Development Kit: what it is, how it builds and releases an app, and what its shared code makes a person hear. Ten walks in the pattern of ten, each three to five minutes.
channel.itunes:author: Jamal Mazrui

item.title: 0 - Overview
item.description: Nothing is needed; this walk is listened to. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0-0-overview

item.title: 1 - User Interface
item.description: Nothing is needed; this walk is listened to. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0a-1-user-interface

item.title: 2 - Install and Launch
item.description: Windows 10 or later, 64-bit, a screen reader running, and HomerDev dot zip downloaded. Everything else the kit fetches for itself. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0b-2-install-and-launch

item.title: 3 - Start an App from the Kit
item.description: The kit is at C colon backslash HomerDev, and a command prompt is open there. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0c-3-start-an-app-from-the-kit

item.title: 4 - Build, Check and Release
item.description: An app built on the kit is open in a command prompt, with a change made and GitHub signed in. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0d-4-build-check-and-release

item.title: 5 - The Installer and Its Finish Page
item.description: A Homer program's installer is downloaded, and your reader is running. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0e-5-the-installer-and-its-finish-page

item.title: 6 - Spoken Tutorials
item.description: An app built on the kit, with its help folder open. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0f-6-spoken-tutorials

item.title: 7 - Shared Code and the Homer Player
item.description: FileDir and DbDo are installed, with mpv. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0g-7-shared-code-and-the-homer-player

item.title: 8 - Build with an AI Assistant
item.description: An app made with newHomerApp, as in walk three, and a command prompt in its folder. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0h-8-build-with-an-ai-assistant

item.title: 9 - Conclusion
item.description: Nothing is needed; this walk is listened to. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0i-9-conclusion
